labels.name: Acromion
labels.function: Bony roof of the space; can press down on the cuff tendon

labels.name: Inferior acromial bone spur
labels.function: Degenerative projection that narrows the space, worsening impingement

labels.name: Subacromial bursa
labels.function: Cushion under the arch; inflames and thickens with impingement

labels.name: Supraspinatus tendon
labels.function: Initiates abduction; the most commonly torn cuff tendon

labels.name: Deltoid
labels.function: Not a cuff muscle; abducts beyond 15 degrees, rarely injured itself

labels.name: Glenohumeral joint capsule
labels.function: Fibroses and contracts in frozen shoulder (lost active+passive ROM)

labels.name: Axillary nerve
labels.function: Its injury is the usual cause of weakness of the lateral shoulder muscle

labels.name: Lateral epicondyle
labels.function: Point tenderness here in tennis elbow

labels.name: Common extensor tendon origin
labels.function: Overuse lesion pained by resisted wrist dorsiflexion and gripping

labels.name: Medial epicondyle
labels.function: Point tenderness here in golfer's elbow

labels.name: Common flexor tendon origin
labels.function: Overuse lesion pained by resisted wrist palmar bending and pronation

labels.name: Abductor pollicis longus tendon
labels.function: Moves the thumb away from the palm; sheath swells in De Quervain

labels.name: Extensor pollicis brevis tendon
labels.function: Straightens the thumb's proximal phalanx; De Quervain partner

labels.name: Ganglion cyst
labels.function: Mucin-rich swelling from a capsule or sheath; half resolve

labels.name: A1 pulley
labels.function: Fibrous sheath band that stops bowstringing; thickens and catches

labels.name: Flexor tendon nodule
labels.function: Swelling forced through the narrow band, then sticks (triggering)

labels.name: Extensor tendon
labels.function: Weaker pull must build force to snap the bent digit straight

labels.name: Prepatellar bursa
labels.function: Inflamed by kneeling pressure (housemaid's knee)

labels.name: Patellar tendon
labels.function: Common overuse tendonitis site below the kneecap (jumper's knee)

labels.name: Meniscus
labels.function: Its tears cause recurrent effusions in adult knees

labels.name: Knee joint cavity
labels.function: Raised pressure pushes synovial fluid out through a one-way valve

labels.name: Baker cyst
labels.function: Soft posterior knee mass of distended bursa filled with synovial fluid

labels.name: Semimembranosus tendon
labels.function: Hamstring tendon bordering the swelling on its medial side

labels.name: Medial head of gastrocnemius
labels.function: Calf muscle head bordering the swelling laterally
